title: Megurine Luka — Elegant Smile〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku, are you in here?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hello, Luka. You came to see me?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. I have something for you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's the fortune Honami drew for you when the girls went to the shrine.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, come to think of it... Didn't they tie their fortunes to a tree outside the shrine?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. It's to have the life force of the tree help grant their wishes.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ah, so that's why...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Honami said to just let her know if you want to have yours tied up too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's so nice of her! She's such a kind girl.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, but sometimes to the point that she ends up taking too much responsibility.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, like when she drew a fortune for you?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. Here, take a look...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait... Is this your fortune?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She drew me another one before coming here because she still felt bad about the very first one.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Haha. Classic Honami...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I thought it was very sweet of her to do this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She really wants us all to have the best of luck this year.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. Have you looked inside yet?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, I'll open it now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A great blessing...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's the best one there is, right? Wow!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It must be full of good predictions, right?
Let's read them together!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm, this one's about our finances... Well, that's meaningless to us.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The part about education doesn't really apply to us either. Or maybe it does? You'll pick up new skills effortlessly. Makes me feel smarter, so I can work with that!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. That sounds right!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We can also skip the bit about health... So next is... Ah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What is it? Something good?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: See here, under general luck?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You won't have to wait long for your dreams to come true. What are you wishing for, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that's already become a reality.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: My dream was for our friends to have a great time playing in a band.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You didn't have to wait at all!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Does Honami know what fortune she got for you this time?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I don't think so.
I'll have to tell her the next time she comes.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You know, I think I have a more exciting idea. Why not tie the fortune somewhere in here for her to find?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, I like that!
But what would be a good spot?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Let's look for a suitable place together!
Whoever finds one first can be the winner!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You always come up with fun ideas!
Okay, I'm game!

rows.Speaker: Luka & Miku
rows.Line: Hehe.
